criteria.description: SBOM adapter package exposes generator interfaces, generator selection IDs, subject-neutral generation requests, source request kinds, generated payload results, and an auto-selection registry with Syft as the required default.
Syft-backed generator uses github.com/anchore/syft/syft library APIs to generate real SPDX JSON and CycloneDX JSON payloads from supported sources and validates emitted JSON format markers.

Optional cdxgen executable adapter generates CycloneDX JSON for repository sources, reports explicit unavailable-binary/disabled errors when requested, and is used by auto selection only when enabled and available.
